quote: “If a man should importune me to give a reason why I loved him, I find it could no otherwise be expressed, than by making answer: because it was he, because it was I.”
source: Michel de Montaigne, Essays, Book I, chapter 27, Of Friendship (trans. Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877)
